title: A Joomla build keeps the tags of the articles it keeps: JA Podcast 190 tag pairings before an Apply, 190 after
steps: Run node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/joomla-kept-tags.test.mjs from the repository root.
Test 1 reads apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts.json and lists every Joomla pin whose Claude Cowork plugin version is below 0.24.1.

Test 2 runs a whole Apply of the Joomla engine over the real JA Podcast j6 1.0.1 contract, Podcast and Pages unticked, against a site double holding the release's 190 tag pairings (articles 1-5 and 8-40, tags 3-7) and the plugin's rule (a write naming tags replaces them, any other write keeps them), and counts the tag map before and after.
expect: Test 1 reports ok: no Joomla pin installs a plugin older than 0.24.1

Test 2 reports ok: the Apply wrote tagged articles (some unpublished), no write named tags, deleted a tag or took a category off, and the tag map holds 190 pairings after the Apply, every article with exactly its own tags
evidence: 08/10/2026, a JA Podcast j6 1.0.1 site: a brief build took #__contentitem_tag_map from 190 rows to 0 (Joomla's Taggable behaviour read an article store naming no tags as every tag removed). Fixed in Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.1 (TracyHQ/claude-cowork c7f4d40), whose own e2e is joomla/cowork/tests/e2e/tags-kept.sh.
fence: The Joomla plugin pin floor (0.24.1) in quickstarts.json, and the Joomla engine's writes never naming tags, deleting tags or trashing categories.

tests: every Joomla pin installs a Claude Cowork plugin that keeps tags
a whole Apply over JA Podcast 1.0.1, Podcast and Pages unticked, keeps every article its five tags
